title: Label
description: Amendment 0001, 34.2. The label of a published object: a medium line, then paragraphs. Fixed structure; one label serves the page, the machine-readable record and the printed catalogue.

medium.description: One line, with no line break and no space at either end.

paragraphs.description: At least one. Each is text without a blank line inside it and without a space at either end.
